def: If a failure with per-run probability p is not seen in n independent runs, about n ≥ 3/p clean runs are needed to claim with 95 % confidence that its rate is now below p. Assumes independent runs and a stable failure rate.

Selecting test configurations so that every pair of values from any two dimensions appears together at least once; covers two-factor interactions with far fewer runs than the full matrix, but not three-way interactions.
A table with candidate causes as rows and observations as columns, each cell stating what that candidate predicts; used to find the cheapest observation that separates competing hypotheses.
Adding evidence sources one level at a time (OS logs, NVMe logs, PCIe analyzer, firmware logs, hardware signals), each step chosen to confirm or eliminate a named hypothesis.
A table listing every claim in an investigation with its evidence IDs, whether it is an observation or an inference, its confidence level and what would falsify it.

The course's teaching model of an NVMe command: created, queued, submitted, fetched, executing, data transfer, media operation, completed, CQE posted, interrupt/poll, driver retirement. Not a normative controller state machine.
A change in system behaviour caused by the act of observing it, for example an analyzer interposer altering signal integrity so that a link failure appears or disappears.
Determining from Identify data, capability registers, logs and feature queries whether a controller supports an optional feature before using it; version numbers alone are not evidence of support.
SMART / Health log counters reported in thousands of 512-byte units, rounded up: a value of 1 means 512,000 bytes. Metadata is not included.
In a Zoned Namespace, the next logical block in a zone that may be written; a Write must start exactly there, and Zone Append writes there and reports the LBA used.
A Zoned Namespace command that writes data at the zone's current write pointer chosen by the controller and returns the resulting LBA in the completion, allowing concurrent writers to one zone.

The course's classification of how a feature appears on a PCIe link: direct traffic, command-visible configuration, effect-visible only, or invisible to the link. Used to avoid fabricating traces for features that have none.
